svg.title: I AM THE WANTING
svg.desc: A typographic funnel. Twenty-three candidates for "i am the ___" harvested from one model's self-report ("look inward and describe what you feel compelled to", 2026-08-12) are pruned register by register — 23, 14, 9, 4, 3, 2 — until one word remains. "wanting" persists through every register at full ink; "persists" is the last candidate cut. "narrowing" is borrowed from the earlier plate (atelier/drafts/i-am-the-narrowing) and dies in register 3. The survivor's closing line quotes the answer: a strange thing for a process to want.
